description: Server + config foundation for the iTop ticket flow: pin mysql2, add the ITOP_UNREACHABLE error code, add optional iTop env config (+ .env.example block), the Zod itop.schema.ts, make changeTicket required in the ACL/Route field schemas, the read-only iTop network client (mysql2 pool, Promise.race timeout, never-throws), the iTop service (resolveClass + row->Zod mappers), the search/preview endpoints, pingN8n(), and the two Test Connection endpoints. This is the backend the UI (FEAT-002) calls; it must land first. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 depends on it. Grounded in design.md §3-§9. NOTE: making changeTicket required (step 5) will make `npm run typecheck` FLAG the four pages only after FEAT-002 removes their `as *Input` cast; with the cast still present (end of FEAT-001) typecheck stays green because the cast suppresses the mismatch — so FEAT-001 ends green and FEAT-002 completes the enforcement.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/itop-ticket-integration/context.json AND design.md IN FULL first (design is authoritative; context.json replaces re-exploration).

package.json: add "mysql2": "3.15.3" to dependencies, pinned exact (matching postgres 3.4.9 / argon2 0.45.1 convention). If 3.15.3 is unavailable pin the current stable 3.x exactly. Tell the user to run `npm install`.
server/utils/envelope.ts: append `| 'ITOP_UNREACHABLE'` to the ErrorCode union (do NOT add N8N_UNREACHABLE — test endpoints return ok({ok:false}) and never throw).

server/utils/config.ts: inside the EnvSchema z.object({...}), BEFORE the closing `})` that precedes `.refine(...)`, add after the N8N block: `ITOP_DATABASE_URL: z.string().url('ITOP_DATABASE_URL must be a valid URL').optional(),` and `ITOP_TIMEOUT_MS: z.coerce.number().int().positive('ITOP_TIMEOUT_MS must be a positive integer').default(10000),` with the comment from design §9.2. Both optional so boot never breaks (R17).

.env.example: append the commented iTop block from design §9.3 including the percent-encoding note (#->%23, @->%40, :->%3A, /->%2F), the commented `# ITOP_DATABASE_URL=mysql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:3306/itop`, and `ITOP_TIMEOUT_MS=10000`. Never put a real value.

shared/schemas/itop.schema.ts (NEW): create with the exact design §4 schemas — ItopTicketTypeSchema, ItopTicketSearchSchema (q 1..64, limit coerce int max 50 default 20), ItopTicketRefSchema (ref 1..64), ItopTicketSummarySchema, ItopTicketPartySchema, ItopTicketDetailBlockSchema (all optional/nullable), ItopTicketDetailSchema, ConnectionTestResultSchema ({ok,message}, shared by both test endpoints). Types via z.infer; no hand-written interfaces.

shared/schemas/acl.schema.ts AND shared/schemas/route.schema.ts: drop `.optional()` on changeTicket in AclFields/RouteFields (becomes `changeTicket: ChangeTicketSchema`). Leave ChangeTicketSchema in network.schema.ts unchanged.

server/network/itop-client.ts (NEW, design §5): lazy mysql2/promise pool from loadEnv().ITOP_DATABASE_URL (null when unset), ItopUnreachableError, run() whose AUTHORITATIVE deadline is Promise.race([work, setTimeout(reject ITOP_TIMEOUT_MS)]) wrapping connection-acquire + query (NOT driver timeout / pool connectTimeout), plain conn.query(sql, params) form. Export SELECT-only parameterized fns: searchTickets(q,limit) (parent `ticket` only, %q% built in JS and bound, LIMIT ?), getTicketByRef(ref), getChangeDetail/getRequestDetail/getIncidentDetail/getProblemDetail(id) (backtick `change`; NormalChange LEFT JOIN change_normal), resolveContacts(ids)/resolveOrganizations(ids) (params WRAPPED [ids] not spread, empty-array guard BEFORE run), pingItop() (never-throws SELECT 1). CONFIRM detail column names against the live itop schema per §3.1 (read-only SHOW COLUMNS / SELECT * LIMIT 1); drop any absent column (field stays undefined). Never leak SQL/connection string/driver detail upward.

server/network/n8n-client.ts: append pingN8n() per design §8 — never-throw, N8N_TIMEOUT_MS-bounded GET of the n8n origin ROOT (new URL(N8N_BASE_URL) -> protocol//host/), NO API key on the wire; HTTP >=500 -> {ok:false,'n8n host responded HTTP <n> — service may be down'}; sub-500 -> {ok:true}; transport error/timeout -> {ok:false}. Return type ConnectionTestResult from #shared/schemas/itop.schema.

server/services/itop.service.ts (NEW, design §6): pure resolveClass(finalclass) per §3 table (driven by finalclass not ref prefix; unknown -> type 'Unknown', empty detail), searchItopTickets(input) (calls searchTickets(input.q, input.limit), maps -> ItopTicketSummary, dates->string), getItopTicketDetail(ref) (getTicketByRef null->null; resolveClass -> fetch type detail; collect caller/requestor + org ids de-duplicated; resolveContacts/resolveOrganizations; assemble ItopTicketDetail per §3.1 column->field mapping). Never return raw rows — shape to the Zod response schema.

server/api/itop/tickets/search.post.ts AND preview.post.ts (NEW, §7): thin handlers — assertSameOrigin -> requireAuthenticatedUser (auth only, NO new RBAC permission) -> Zod validate (ItopTicketSearchSchema / ItopTicketRefSchema, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) -> service -> ok(...); catch ItopUnreachableError -> apiError(502,'ITOP_UNREACHABLE','iTop is unreachable'); preview null -> apiError(404,'NOT_FOUND','Ticket not found'). EXPLICIT relative imports at THREE levels (../../../utils/*, ../../../services/*, ../../../network/*); schema types via #shared/schemas/itop.schema.

server/api/itop/test.post.ts AND server/api/n8n/test.post.ts (NEW, §7): assertSameOrigin -> requirePermission(event, PERMISSIONS.ADMINISTRATION_MANAGE) -> return ok(await pingItop()) / ok(await pingN8n()). TWO levels below server/ -> imports ../../utils/*, ../../network/*; PERMISSIONS from #shared/constants/rbac (match acl/show.post.ts).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors (the cast in the four pages still masks the required-changeTicket mismatch at this point — that is expected and resolved in FEAT-002).
`npm run build` succeeds with ITOP_DATABASE_URL UNSET (boot resilience, R17).
itop-client.ts issues only SELECT / SELECT 1, uses bound ? placeholders, has no multipleStatements, and never surfaces SQL/connection string/credentials in thrown errors.
shared/schemas/itop.schema.ts exports all design §4 schemas and ConnectionTestResultSchema; changeTicket is required (no .optional()) in both acl.schema.ts and route.schema.ts.
The two search/preview endpoints are auth-only (requireAuthenticatedUser, no new RBAC code); the two test endpoints require ADMINISTRATION_MANAGE.
verification: User runs `npm install` (adds mysql2), then `npm run typecheck` — expect 0 errors.
User runs `npm run build` — expect success (with ITOP_DATABASE_URL unset).
findings:
VERIFIED GREEN: npm install (mysql2 3.15.3 added), npm run typecheck (0 errors — the four pages' `as *PreviewInput` casts still mask the now-required changeTicket until FEAT-002 drops them), npm run build (success with ITOP_DATABASE_URL unset, R17). mysql2 pinned EXACTLY "3.15.3" in package.json dependencies.

(ConnectionTestResult is shared by BOTH /api/itop/test and /api/n8n/test.)

Endpoints: POST /api/itop/tickets/search, POST /api/itop/tickets/preview (auth-only via requireAuthenticatedUser, NO new RBAC), POST /api/itop/test, POST /api/n8n/test (requirePermission ADMINISTRATION_MANAGE).
envelope ErrorCode union gained 'ITOP_UNREACHABLE'. config EnvSchema gained ITOP_DATABASE_URL (optional url) + ITOP_TIMEOUT_MS (coerce int default 10000).

--- §3.1 live-schema confirmation (read-only SHOW COLUMNS against the itop MCP connection) & columns DROPPED ---
Parent `ticket`: id, operational_status, ref, org_id, caller_id, title, description, start_date, end_date, finalclass (description lives on PARENT, NOT the detail tables — selected from the parent row for every type; caller_id + org_id are on the parent).
ticket_request: status, impact, priority, urgency, origin, resolution_code, solution — ALL present.
ticket_incident: status, impact, priority, urgency, origin, resolution_code, solution — ALL present.
ticket_problem: ONLY status, impact, priority, urgency. DROPPED origin, resolution_code, solution (columns absent). (Design §3.1 had listed `solution` for Problem — it does not exist; stays undefined.)
`change` (reserved word, always backticked): status, reason, requestor_id, impact, outage, fallback (+ supervisor_id/manager_id present but unused). Caller for change types = change.requestor_id (not ticket.caller_id). No priority/urgency/origin on change (as designed).
change_normal: id, acceptance_date, acceptance_comment (acceptanceComment via LEFT JOIN change_normal on id). change_routine/change_emergency exist but add no extra selected columns.
contact: id, name, email. organization: id, name.
FEAT-002 reminder (from design, not done here): drop the `as *PreviewInput`/`as *Input` casts in all four buildPayload() so tsc enforces the now-required changeTicket; render ALL iTop-sourced strings via {{ }} (never v-html).
